    const player = e.target.contentDocument.getElementById('kl-svg').player;
    player.ready((p) => {

<template>
  <object ref="anim" type="image/svg+xml" data="/sunrise-badge.svg" aria-label="Sunrise badge"
    style="width:100%;max-width:320px" @load="onLoad" />
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, onBeforeUnmount } from "vue";

const anim = ref(null);
let player = null;

function onLoad() {
  player = anim.value.contentDocument?.getElementById("kl-svg")?.player;
  player.ready((p) => {
    p.on('end', () => console.log('finished'));
    // p.play(); p.pause(); p.reverse(); p.seek(50); p.set('speed', 2);
  });
}

onBeforeUnmount(() => player?.destruct());
</script>
